title: cover the supervisor's guard loops, and stop tests from being able to reach the network

AC1.note: tests/fixtures/fake-fetch.ts: requests[] records method/url/headers/parsed JSON body; program() by URL pattern, same match replaces

AC2.note: unmatched request rejects naming method and URL; asserted in fixtures.test.ts and still recorded so the test can see the attempt

AC3.note: preload calls installNetworkGuard(); fixtures.test.ts asserts the rejection names the URL and installFakeFetch

AC4.note: whole suite green with the guard active — 791 pass 0 fail; any real fetch would have rejected

AC5.note: provider-service.test.ts uses installFakeFetch; the globalThis.fetch swap and its restore are gone

AC6.note: checkUnansweredMessages, checkHungSessions, checkStuckQueue exported; signatures and bodies unchanged

AC7.note: re-injected row asserted: session/chat/from_user/content marked, telegram_msg_id carried, delivered false in the statement text

AC8.note: reaction asserted on chat_id + message_id + emoji, and asserted still set for an already-requeued message — current order

AC9.note: already-requeued message inserts nothing and sends no alert

AC10.note: second sweep inside the window does nothing; a failing insert consumes the window and the next sweep inserts nothing

AC11.note: alert asserts project, path, elapsed; payloads compared against restartCallbackData/paneCallbackData/ackCallbackData; incident row asserted

AC12.note: already-alerted path: one send total, editMessageText carries the original message_id and appends

AC13.note: spinner reported and the restart button warns; with no RunShell the session is still alerted, without the pane block

AC14.note: stuck alert asserts count, wait, preview, pane, force-deliver by session and restart by project; healthy queue sends nothing

AC15.note: mutation: emptying each loop body fails 8/11, 7/9 and 6/7 of its tests; survivors are the do-nothing cases

AC16.note: typecheck clean, lint 0 errors, 791 pass, dupes 1, supervisor 5.55% to 32.07% lines and 7.69% to 54.55% funcs, health 64
